entries.zh: 巡演练习 · 旧档保留
把一个动机，写成一首曲子。
entries.en: Turn one motif into a whole song.

entries.zh: 四个乐段 · 六轨十六步 · 自己写旋律和段落，没有标准答案。
entries.en: Four sections · six tracks · sixteen steps. Write your own melody and arrangement; there is no right answer.

entries.zh: 从 A 段开始。点格子改变力度，选中旋律格后可修改音高。
entries.en: Start with section A. Click cells to change strength; select a melody cell to change its pitch.

entries.zh: 六轨音序器，可左右滚动
空 → 轻 → 正 → 重，点按循环。左右滑动看完整 16 格；M 静音、S 独奏。选中音符后用下方控制精确编辑。
entries.en: Empty → Light → Normal → Heavy, click to cycle. Swipe sideways to see all 16 steps; M mutes, S solos. After selecting a note, fine-tune it with the controls below.

entries.zh: 引用同一乐段会同步更新；想做新变化，先复制到另一段。每张卡可选段落、重复次数和顺序。
entries.en: Using the same section twice keeps both in sync; to make a new variation, copy it to another section first. Each card sets the section, repeats and order.

entries.zh: 循环试听（导出只渲染编排一遍）
entries.en: Loop playback (export renders the arrangement once)

entries.zh: 自动保存到当前浏览器
从较低系统音量开始。百分比不是实际声压或听力安全保证。
entries.en: Start with a low system volume. The percentage is not an actual sound level or a hearing-safety guarantee.

entries.zh: 工程码完整保存可编辑内容；WAV 是可播放音频。仅在本地处理，不上传作品或请求麦克风。
entries.en: The project code keeps everything editable; the WAV is playable audio. Everything is processed locally: nothing is uploaded and the microphone is never requested.

entries.zh: ① 在 A 段改出喜欢的鼓点；点低音、和弦或主奏，再选音高。
entries.en: 1. In section A, edit a drum pattern you like; click bass, chords or lead, then pick a pitch.

entries.zh: ② 复制 A 到 B，尝试移位或变奏；都能撤销。
entries.en: 2. Copy A to B and try shifting or varying it; everything can be undone.

entries.zh: ③ 把 A、B 排成段落，选择重复次数，试听整曲后导出。
entries.en: 3. Arrange A and B into sections, set the repeats, play the whole song, then export.

entries.zh: 四种音色自由开放。想练基础拍型，可切到原巡演；两个模式与存档互不覆盖。
entries.en: All four sounds are open. To practise basic rhythms, switch to the original Tour; the two modes and their saves never overwrite each other.

entries.zh: 空格试听/停止当前段；Esc 停止或关弹窗；格子内方向键移动，Enter/空格改力度。编辑或转入后台会停止试听，再播放时使用最新快照。
entries.en: Space plays/stops the current section; Esc stops or closes a dialog; arrow keys move inside the grid, Enter/Space changes strength. Editing or going to the background stops playback, and the next play uses the latest snapshot.

entries.zh: 复制 PULSESONG1 工程码给朋友，或下载工程文件。支持导入旧 PULSE2 的三个网格（旧档未存速度，按 112 BPM 恢复）。先完整验证再替换，失败保留原作品。
entries.en: Copy the PULSESONG1 project code to a friend, or download the project file. The three grids of an old PULSE2 save can be imported (old saves have no tempo, so 112 BPM is used). Everything is checked before replacing; if it fails, your song is kept.

entries.zh: 节拍顺序或结束时间无效
entries.en: Beat order or end time is invalid

entries.zh: 乐曲必须完整覆盖零到结束时间
entries.en: The song must cover zero to the end time completely

entries.zh: 音频设备暂停，请重新播放
entries.en: Audio device paused, please play again

entries.zh: 播放调度中断，已停止以避免音符堆叠；请重新播放
entries.en: Playback scheduling was interrupted and stopped to avoid stacked notes; please play again

entries.zh: 音符密度过高，已停止播放
entries.en: Too many notes at once, playback stopped

entries.zh: 此浏览器不支持 Web Audio
entries.en: This browser does not support Web Audio

entries.zh: 音频未获准启动，请点击播放重试
entries.en: Audio was not allowed to start, click play to retry

entries.zh: 导出采样率仅支持 22050 或 44100 Hz
entries.en: Export sample rate must be 22050 or 44100 Hz

entries.zh: 此浏览器不支持离线音频导出
entries.en: This browser does not support offline audio export

entries.zh: 六轨强弱拍音序器与十二场巡演委托。点按格子循环切换空拍、轻拍、正拍和重音。
entries.en: A six-track beat sequencer and twelve tour gigs. Click a cell to cycle rest, light, normal and accent.

entries.zh: 每 4 格为一拍组，格子亮框表示当前播放位置
entries.en: Every 4 steps is one beat group; the lit cell border shows the current playing position

entries.zh: 完成三项必要条件获得一星；附加目标和精简编辑可继续提升评价。
entries.en: Pass the three required goals for one star; bonus goals and fewer edits raise the rating further.

entries.zh: 包含场次星级、听众、音色选择与三个作品槽。首次播放仍需点击授权声音。
entries.en: Holds gig stars, fans, sound choice and the three song slots. The first play still needs a click to allow sound.

entries.zh: 用稳定四拍和军鼓反拍建立最基础的舞池骨架。
entries.en: Build the most basic dance-floor skeleton with a steady four-on-the-floor kick and a snare backbeat.

entries.zh: 让踩镲填入弱拍，同时保持至少三条轨道参与。
entries.en: Put the hi-hat on the weak beats while keeping at least three tracks playing.

entries.zh: 让低音与底鼓在关键位置咬合，但不要把每一格塞满。
entries.en: Lock the bass with the kick at key points, but do not fill every step.

entries.zh: 主动留出连续空拍，并用重音把听众带回节奏。
entries.en: Leave a run of empty steps on purpose, then use accents to bring the audience back to the rhythm.

entries.zh: 前半段用和弦提问，后半段让主奏作答。
entries.en: Ask with chords in the first half, answer with the lead in the second half.

entries.zh: 把足够多的音符放在奇数格，制造向前倾斜的切分感。
entries.en: Place enough notes on odd steps to create a forward-leaning syncopation.

entries.zh: 限制音符总量，让四条以上轨道各自承担清晰职责。
entries.en: Limit the total notes so that four or more tracks each have a clear role.

entries.zh: 后八格的总强度必须明显高于前八格，形成一次渐强。
entries.en: The last eight steps must be clearly stronger than the first eight, making one crescendo.

entries.zh: 让低音避开部分底鼓，结合踩镲弱拍形成机械交错。
entries.en: Keep the bass off some kick hits and combine it with weak-beat hi-hats for a mechanical interlock.

entries.zh: 六轨全部加入，四拍底鼓与军鼓反拍仍必须清晰。
entries.en: Add all six tracks; the four-on-the-floor kick and snare backbeat must still stay clear.

entries.zh: 复杂并不等于拥挤：制造强变化，同时限制同格叠层。
entries.en: Complex does not mean crowded: create strong changes while limiting layers on a single step.

entries.zh: 整合巡演中学到的稳定、切分、留白、重音与六轨编排。
entries.en: Combine everything the tour taught: steadiness, syncopation, space, accents and six-track arrangement.

entries.zh: 巡演档案无法保存，请用档案码备份；本局仍可继续。
entries.en: The tour file could not be saved; back it up with the file code. This round can continue.

entries.zh: 切换练习会清空当前网格。先保存作品槽可以保留，是否继续？
entries.en: Switching practice will clear the current grid. Saving to a song slot first keeps it. Continue?

entries.zh: 速度已修改，重新播放后生效。
entries.en: Tempo changed; it takes effect on the next play.
Tour file is too large or invalid
Tour file version is not compatible
This slot has no song yet.

entries.zh: 档案已生成，请手动复制。
entries.en: File generated, please copy it manually.

entries.zh: 无法读取草稿，已打开起始乐段。原损坏草稿未被覆盖；请先导出作品备份。
entries.en: The draft could not be read; the starter section was opened. The damaged draft was not overwritten; please export your song as a backup first.

entries.zh: 浏览器无法保存，请导出工程码备份；本局仍可继续。
entries.en: The browser cannot save; export the project code as a backup. This round can continue.

entries.zh: 草稿已自动保存 · 仅当前浏览器
编辑后已停止试听，再播放会使用最新作品。
entries.en: Playback stopped after editing; the next play uses the latest song.

entries.zh: 已撤销，包括音高、编排和配置。
entries.en: Undone, including pitch, arrangement and settings.

entries.zh: 段。切换已停止试听；修改会同步到所有引用。
entries.en: . Switching stopped playback; changes sync to every reference.

entries.zh: 秒 · 最多 32 小节 / 180 秒
当前有独奏轨道，其余轨道不发声。
entries.en: A track is soloed; the other tracks are silent.

entries.zh: 音符数不代表作品质量，听见你的取舍才是重点。
entries.en: The number of notes does not measure quality; what matters is hearing your choices.

entries.zh: 正在试听当前乐段。编辑会停止试听。
entries.en: Playing the current section. Editing stops playback.

entries.zh: 正在试听整曲编排。白框跟随音频时钟，切到后台会停止。
entries.en: Playing the whole arrangement. The white frame follows the audio clock; going to the background stops playback.

entries.zh: 秒作品；导出使用此刻快照。
entries.en: s of song; the export uses a snapshot from this moment.

entries.zh: WAV 已导出 · 单声道 44.1kHz / PCM16 ·

entries.en: · whole mix lowered to prevent clipping.

entries.zh: 导出失败，工程保持不变：

entries.en: . You can download the project code as a backup first.

entries.zh: 工程只在本地生成；工程码不是加密数据。
entries.en: The project is generated locally only; the project code is not encrypted.

entries.zh: Swing 已修改，成对细分总时长不变。
entries.en: Swing changed; the total length of paired subdivisions is unchanged.

entries.zh: 当前乐段循环左移一格。
entries.en: Current section looped one step left.

entries.zh: 当前乐段循环右移一格。
entries.en: Current section looped one step right.

entries.zh: 变奏种子需要 0–4294967295 的整数。
entries.en: The variation seed must be a whole number from 0 to 4294967295.

entries.zh: 的变奏；只影响当前段，可撤销。
entries.en: ; it only affects the current section and can be undone.

entries.zh: 请选择另一个目标乐段。
entries.en: Please choose a different target section.
Overwrite the existing notes in section

entries.zh: 段现有音符？之后可以撤销。

entries.en: ; they can be edited separately from now on.

entries.zh: 清空当前乐段？可以撤销，其他乐段不变。
entries.en: Clear the current section? You can undo this; other sections stay unchanged.

entries.zh: 已将当前段加入歌曲末尾。
entries.en: Added the current section to the end of the song.

entries.zh: 循环选项已修改，重新播放后生效。
entries.en: Loop option changed; it takes effect on the next play.

entries.zh: 完整工程已保存到作品架
entries.en: The full project was saved to shelf

entries.zh: 作品架写入失败；当前草稿未改变，请导出工程码。
entries.en: Writing to the shelf failed; the current draft is unchanged, please export the project code.

entries.zh: 完整工程已载入；可以撤销恢复之前作品。
entries.en: The full project was loaded; you can undo to restore the previous song.

entries.zh: 新建空白作品？当前工程可撤销恢复，也建议先下载备份。
entries.en: Start a new blank song? The current project can be restored with undo, but downloading a backup first is wise.

entries.zh: 剪贴板不可用，请手动复制选中的工程码。
entries.en: Clipboard unavailable, please copy the selected project code manually.

entries.zh: 旧作品槽已迁移到 A–C，旧档未记录速度，按 112 BPM 恢复。
entries.en: Old song slots were moved to A–C; old saves record no tempo, so 112 BPM is used.

entries.zh: 工程验证成功，完整设置已恢复；可以撤销。
entries.en: Project verified and all settings restored; you can undo.

entries.zh: 导入被拒绝，原工程未改变：
文件已读取，点击“验证并导入”才会替换。
entries.en: File read; click “Check and import” to replace.

entries.zh: 已读取巡演三个作品槽至 A–C；原巡演不变，BPM 采用 112。
entries.en: The three Tour song slots were read into A–C; the original Tour is unchanged and BPM is set to 112.
The old song cannot be migrated:

entries.zh: 页面转入后台，试听已停止，草稿保持不变。
entries.en: The page went to the background, playback stopped, and the draft is unchanged.

entries.zh: 草稿未覆盖 · 请先备份
entries.en: Draft not overwritten · back up first

entries.zh: 自动保存到当前浏览器 · 编辑后保存
entries.en: Autosaves in this browser · save after editing
